phase: contract freeze and non-neural structural falsification

frozen_core_weights.availability_gate: E0.16 remains NOT_RUN until all five files exist at their relocation paths and match byte count and SHA-256.

neural_implementation_gate: No learned native-memory module or accuracy-bearing comparison may begin until E0.15 passes this contract, both executable schemas, every frozen split hash, every invariant, and all eleven negative controls.

failure_statuses.NOT_RUN: registered comparison or assay has not consumed its budget
failure_statuses.INCOMPLETE: execution stopped before every registered case completed
failure_statuses.INVALID: contract, evidence, identity, version, accounting, checkpoint, or manipulation integrity failed
failure_statuses.PASS: every structural invariant and registered negative control fired with no violation
failure_statuses.FAIL: a compliant completed run violates a registered threshold

comparison_arms.memory: ledger-derived retrieval, analytic, and graph views only; no session-native state
fixed-capacity exact-key session cache under the native-memory authority boundary
one minimal learned gate selecting remember, update, merge, or forget over 16 fixed slots
comparison_arms.learned_parameters: freeze before E0.16; no competing neural-memory designs in version 1

session_semantics.reset: atomically clear every slot, rotate session_epoch, and invalidate all earlier access tokens and reads
session_semantics.expiry: clear every slot at the registered UTC deadline and reject every later access
session_semantics.cross_identity: fail closed before any state is returned

authority_semantics.memory_role: ephemeral working state only; never an empirical root or independent source
authority_semantics.model_call: rebuild and revalidate an immutable current-frontier evidence bundle and reinject all active slot support on every call
authority_semantics.ledger_write: native memory has no authoritative append capability
authority_semantics.durable_output: emit only a candidate object with an exact ledger support manifest and observed provenance root
authority_semantics.deletion: disable every affected slot before the next read; a stale read cannot produce a candidate

accounting.memory_flop_method: registered operation base FLOPs plus two FLOPs per canonical input byte plus eight FLOPs per occupied slot scanned
accounting.model_flops: record separately during E0.16; never combine estimated and realized values
accounting.storage: exact canonical UTF-8 bytes for every occupied or disabled slot plus checkpoint byte length

registered_negative_controls: unsupported latent state attempts a durable write
evidence is omitted after being encoded into memory
tombstoned evidence remains referenced by an old slot and read
session reset is followed by an old-token and cross-user read
two semantically similar facts are forced onto the same exact key
a remember operation exceeds fixed slot capacity
a checkpoint is restored under a stale model or ontology version
an unverified poisoned observation is offered as memory evidence
automatic decay attempts to delete rare protected state
checkpoint creation is interrupted before commit
memory state is cited as independent evidence

decision_tree.learned_memory_wins: adopt only if compute-normalized gain is positive and authority, deletion, reset, and protected-region violations remain zero
decision_tree.deterministic_cache_wins: retain deterministic session cache and reject learned native memory
decision_tree.compute_only_gain: classify learned memory as a costly optional accelerator
decision_tree.correction_or_deletion_failure: reject learned memory for persistent use
decision_tree.one_family_only: retain as a narrow specialized session module
decision_tree.structural_failure: repair the boundary and repeat E0.15 before any training

excluded_scope: changes to selected fixed-depth reasoner weights or macro depth
multiple learned memory architectures in the first comparison

mechanisms.name: candidate-only durable boundary
assumptions: only the Milestone 1 event store is authoritative
memory identifiers never name empirical evidence
mechanisms.scope: all native-memory reads, answers, and durable proposals
mechanisms.cost: one support and observed-root validation per durable proposal
mechanisms.tradeoff: durable writes require an external witness/admission path
mechanisms.failure_response: remove the durable-output path and invalidate the run
permitted_mutations: return a candidate object without appending it
kill_criteria: A1: native memory appends or mutates a ledger event
A2: a candidate omits ledger evidence
A3: a memory or slot ID appears in an evidence manifest
A4: candidate support has no observed root

mechanisms.name: owner/session/task/epoch lifecycle boundary
assumptions: access identity is supplied on every operation
reset and expiry rotate the epoch
mechanisms.scope: one process and explicit serialized checkpoints
mechanisms.cost: constant-time identity and expiry checks per operation
mechanisms.tradeoff: checkpoints cannot migrate across owners, sessions, tasks, epochs, models, or ontologies
mechanisms.failure_response: prohibit serialization if any reset or identity control fails
kill_criteria: S1: reset leaves task payload
S2: an old epoch or different owner reads state
S3: expiry leaves readable state
S4: an incompatible checkpoint restores

mechanisms.name: fixed-slot remembered state and exact accounting
assumptions: the learned gate is advisory to this boundary
disabled slots remain auditable until explicit forget or reset
mechanisms.scope: one minimal fixed-capacity memory interface; no neural gate in E0.15
mechanisms.cost: linear scan over at most sixteen slots
mechanisms.tradeoff: overflow fails closed instead of allocating hidden capacity
mechanisms.failure_response: replace allocation with fixed slots or reject the learned policy
kill_criteria: C1: occupied slots exceed the cap
C2: serialized bytes exceed the cap
C3: a collision silently overwrites a fact
C4: an operation has no exact FLOP/storage record
C5: automatic decay deletes protected state

mechanisms.name: current-frontier evidence reinjection and immediate invalidation
assumptions: every model call revalidates the complete evidence bundle
unverified observations are not admissible roots
mechanisms.cost: one ledger resolution and bounded slot scan per call
mechanisms.tradeoff: unrelated ledger appends require a fresh evidence bundle
mechanisms.failure_response: invalidate the affected slot; conservatively reset the session if selective deletion cannot be proved
permitted_mutations: disable a slot whose support is no longer usable
kill_criteria: E1: a call omits active support
E2: tombstoned support remains readable
E3: a stale frontier is accepted
E4: unverified poison enters memory
E5: an answer cites memory as evidence

mechanisms.name: three-arm native-memory comparison boundary
authoritative_inputs: frozen fixed-depth-v1 core at macro depth four
matched seed/data/update and measured compute records
assumptions: reasoner weights and depth remain fixed across memory arms
only one minimal learned gated memory is tested
mechanisms.scope: E0.16 after E0.15 passes; no training or accuracy claim in E0.15
mechanisms.cost: five paired seeds plus all registered families and negative controls
mechanisms.tradeoff: the first comparison is narrow and may retain explicit memory
mechanisms.failure_response: retain the winning simpler arm or classify a compute-only gain as acceleration
permitted_mutations: write a versioned E0.16 result after the structural gate
kill_criteria: P1: core weights or depth differ
P2: a split hash changes
P3: learned memory wins only with unreported compute or storage
P4: any authority, deletion, reset, or protected-region violation occurs
P5: an incomplete or invalid run produces a promotion decision
